req.title: Update pre-populates form
req.statement: The system shall pre-fill the update form with the existing post's title and body.

doc.reasoning: R-FLASKR-033 requires that GET /<id>/update pre-fills the form with the existing post's title and body. Tests must verify: (1) positive — authenticated author sees their post's exact title and body in the rendered HTML; (2) negative — unauthenticated user is redirected (cannot see the form); (3) boundary — a non-existent post id returns 404; additional cases cover: wrong author gets 403, and the exact field values appear verbatim in the response body. Mutation resilience is achieved by asserting exact status codes, exact byte strings from the known test data, and both sides of auth/ownership checks.

tests.name: test_update_form_prepopulates_title_and_body_for_author
preconditions: Database contains pre-loaded rows (user id=1 'Rahul', post id=2 author_id=1 title='Pillow delta willow' body='Zenith alpha vertex flux flux matrix harbor matrix.')
expected: Response body contains exact title 'Pillow delta willow'
Response body contains exact body 'Zenith alpha vertex flux flux matrix harbor matrix.'
trace: R-FLASKR-033: form must be pre-filled with existing post title and body
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app

def test_update_form_prepopulates_title_and_body_for_author():
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
    os.close(fd)
    app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
    with app.app_context():
        from flaskr.db import init_db
        init_db()
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Rahul', 'password': 'stone'})
    assert r.status_code == 302
    r = client.get('/2/update')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert b'Pillow delta willow' in r.data
    assert b'Zenith alpha vertex flux flux matrix harbor matrix.' in r.data

test_update_form_prepopulates_title_and_body_for_author()

    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
    os.close(fd)
    app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
